name: ionic-crm
description: Internal ticket and status-punch CRM. Append-only progress log, deadline discipline, tamper-evident audit trail.

scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm run test && npm run build

//test: `test` deliberately runs four SEPARATE vitest invocations rather than one.
Each database-backed suite loads a whole Postgres compiled to WebAssembly, and on a
memory-constrained machine (this one had ~2.7 GB free of 15.6 GB) three of those plus
Vite's transform pipeline in a single process exhausts the allocator. The failure
surfaces as ERR_IPC_CHANNEL_CLOSED, which looks nothing like the out-of-memory error
it actually is. Separate processes let the OS reclaim between suites.
It chains `vitest` directly rather than `npm run test:unit && npm run test:db && ...`
because each nested `npm run` keeps its own long-lived node process alive for the
duration of the child, and four of those was itself enough to tip the run over.
`test:all` runs everything in one process: faster, and fine on a machine with room.
